metadata.rights_scope: Compact independently restated factual metadata and one derived interior locator only, with attribution. No open licence is asserted. Beale reserves rights and prohibits reproduction or retransmission of its content without permission; no publisher prose, raw HTML, photographs, logos or renderings are redistributed. Public planning access does not grant a reuse licence for survey drawings or aerial imagery; no PDF, source map or reconstructed polygon is redistributed. Survey facts support a locator only, not a surveyed or approved campus boundary.

metadata.date_semantics: Contemporary developer current-status disclosure, not an inspection date or the older October2025 groundbreaking. September retrieval does not refresh status.
metadata.authority_basis: Developer-published joint announcement with named Google and Beale representatives; direct campus current-status assertion. No judicial, regulatory inspection or third-party reporter observation inferred.
metadata.project_scope: Current campus construction, without asserting an individual building or trade milestone. The old unselected initial-phase project stays historical; future buildings do not become additional sites.
metadata.successor_review: Bounded September10 searches of Beale and Tulsa Planning found no project-specific completion or cancellation superseding August19. The undated developer page forecasts Phase1 completion inQ3 2027. March4 draft minutes record withdrawal of the accelerated permit request, not campus cancellation, and predate the selected August19 disclosure. No exhaustive absence claim.
